budget.meaning: 模型轮次为硬上限；已报告token为调用间软阈值，不是费用硬上限，单次返回可能超出；启用token阈值时，缺用量会暂停后续请求。

cooperative_cancellation.scope: Real official request returned, cooperative cancellation stopped subsequent tools; in-flight request may be billed.

limits: Shared public files and synthetic tasks; not independent engineering accuracy. Token threshold is soft, cancellation does not abort in-flight HTTP or refund usage.
